headline: The qutrit H27 center already acting on the E8 family C^3 factor is exactly the newly certified physical FI Z3 central character. In the Pass5727 Schrödinger convention ZX=omega XZ, [Z,X]=omega I; the measured FI action is the same omega I on (27,3), omega^2 I on (27bar,3bar), and identity on E6+A2. Hence z_H27=z_FI=exp(2*pi*i Qpsi/3) as an E8 central-character action.

identity.physical_FI_generator: central SU(3) element omega I_3 on the family triplet

what_this_upgrades: Pass5727 previously proved a finite Heisenberg/projective torsion action on the E8 family multiplicity factor but left its physical family-center interpretation open. The measured FI/Qpsi theorem now identifies its scalar center exactly.
what_remains_open: The noncentral H27 generators X and Z are finite qutrit operators. This theorem does not identify the older affine Lie su(3) construction with the full E8 family SU(3) Lie algebra, prove a heterotic vacuum, or assign observed generations.
